$comment: Import map for the Edge Functions runtime.
This file exists so that supabase/functions/_shared/lib can stay byte-identical
to src/lib. Those files were written for Vite and use two conventions Deno does
not share by default: the @data/ alias, and extensionless relative imports
(./schemas rather than ./schemas/index.ts). Both are resolution concerns, not
code concerns — mapping them here keeps the promise docs/MIGRATION.md makes,
which is that the library crosses the boundary unchanged.
src/lib/shared-parity.test.ts fails if the two copies ever diverge.
